files.remoteOnly: This action is only available on the PC running the server. Use Save or Copy path instead.
files.htmlOnly: Only HTML files can be opened in a browser.
files.tooMany: Too many open requests in a row. Wait a moment and try again.

relayUrl.invalid: The relay URL is not valid
relayUrl.httpsOnly: The relay URL must start with https://
relayUrl.httpsOnlyLoopback: The relay URL must start with https:// (http is only allowed for a relay on this PC)
relayUrl.noUserinfo: The relay URL can't contain a user name or password
relayUrl.noQuery: The relay URL can't contain ? or #

pairingCode.notCode: This is not a pairing code
pairingCode.unsupportedVersion: This pairing code is from an unsupported version
pairingCode.hostIdMismatch: The pairing code's hostId doesn't match its public key

closed.badRequest: The relay didn't understand the request (possibly a version mismatch)
closed.unauthorized: The relay rejected the enrollment secret
closed.replaced: Replaced by another connection from the same host (are two Pleiad instances running with the same data folder?)
closed.full: The relay has reached its host limit
closed.lost: Lost the connection to the relay

relay.rateLimited: The relay is temporarily refusing connections (too many failed authentications)

settings.needConfig: Enter the relay URL and the enrollment secret
settings.secretWhitespace: The enrollment secret can't contain spaces
settings.needConfigToEnable: Enter the relay URL and the enrollment secret before turning this on

pairing.requestGone: That pairing request no longer exists

device.revoked: This device was removed on the host
device.lost: Lost the connection to the host
device.tokenRequired: A token is required (open this from the app)

page.hostOffline: Make sure Pleiad is running on the host. This page opens automatically once connected.
page.offline: Can't reach the relay. Check your network. This page opens automatically once connected.

pair.ticket: This pairing code can't be used (already used or expired). Create a new one on the host
pair.rate: Too many pairing attempts. Wait a moment and try again
pair.hostOffline: Can't reach the host. Make sure Pleiad is running on the host
pair.keyMismatch: The host's key doesn't match the pairing code
pair.timeout: Timed out waiting for approval on the host
pair.expired: The request expired while waiting for approval on the host
